div.div: 1 · 26 November, 08:33 UTC. The pull request that added the ScaledObject was merged with three values still SET-ME. The server dry run refused it (spec.maxReplicaCount must be of type integer), so every deploy failed before it changed anything, moks-cms release restarts included. The site kept its 2 pods.

text.tspan: 1 · 26 November, 08:33 UTC. The pull request that added the ScaledObject was merged with three values still SET-ME. The server dry run refused it (spec.maxReplicaCount
must be of type integer), so every deploy failed before it changed anything, moks-cms release restarts included. The site kept its 2 pods.

div.div: 2 · After #25 the plan step named each SET-ME and stopped, so the failure showed on the pull request itself. Since #26 it leaves a ScaledObject with any SET-ME out, with one warning per value, and deploys the rest; a SET-ME in any other kind still stops the run.

text.tspan: 2 · After #25 the plan step named each SET-ME and stopped, so the failure showed on the pull request itself. Since #26 it leaves a ScaledObject with any SET-ME out, with
one warning per value, and deploys the rest; a SET-ME in any other kind still stops the run.
